# A timeline ignores the columns before it in its scrolling region

## Context

Found while building #21626, whose 390 px layout lets every column but the task tree scroll with the chart through `responsiveLockPolicy`. With those six columns (488 px) out of the locked region, every dependency link draws 488 px left of its bars, over the table.

Repro on `dev` `09061d53ac`, one local edit to `examples/gantt/basic/Viewport.mjs:45`:

```js
taskColumns:[{type:'tree',dataField:'title',text:'Task',width:220,locked:'start'}, {dataField:'percentDone',text:'Done',width:300,locked:null}],
```

At 1440 × 900, each `path[data-dependency-id]` end point measured against its two bars (`getPointAtLength` × `getScreenCTM`):

```
survey-design    dx=-300
design-materials dx=-300
```

Both links start 300 px left of their source bar's right edge: the width of the unlocked column. Bars themselves sit right.

## The Problem

Three readers place or window the timeline from its scrolling region's left edge instead of the timeline column's own:

1. `Neo.gantt.DependencyLayer` mounts in the center body at `left: 0px` (`src/gantt/DependencyLayer.mjs:131`) and projects `[scrollLeft - bufferPx, scrollLeft + viewportWidth + bufferPx]` (`:414-415`) with the region's `scrollLeft` (`src/gantt/Container.mjs:349-351`, `:374`). This is the measured offset.
2. `Neo.timeline.Column#getVisibleDateRange` (`src/timeline/Column.mjs:1011`) windows its bars with the same region `scrollLeft` (`:527-532`). Once the columns before it are wider than `bufferPx` (400, `:55`), bars at the timeline's visible left edge fall outside the window.
3. `Neo.timeline.TimeAxisHeader#getVisibleDateRange` (`src/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.mjs:623`, scroll from `:497-502`) windows its tick labels the same way.

Drags are not affected: `Neo.scheduler.Container` reads the track's DOM rect at drag start (`src/scheduler/Container.mjs:1136-1143`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `Neo.scheduler.Container#buildSchedulerColumns(extraColumns)` (`src/scheduler/Container.mjs:553`) puts the task or resource columns first as `{locked: 'start', ...col}` (`:561-566`), then `extraColumns` unlocked (`:570-584`), then the timeline column. A task column whose descriptor says `locked: null`, and every extra column, lands in the center region before the timeline.
- `Neo.grid.Container#responsiveLockPolicy_` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:205-213`) moves columns between regions by width; `sortColumns` (`:1392`) keeps the unlocked ones in collection order, so they precede the timeline.
- Each region body records `columnPositions` as `{dataField, width, x}` (`src/grid/header/Toolbar.mjs:448-458`). The timeline column's `x` in the center body is the offset the three readers miss.
- Design authority: `buildSchedulerColumns` takes "Additional columns" and places them unlocked before the timeline, and `responsiveLockPolicy_` is "Declarative width breakpoints for moving columns between locked regions". Both are supported states in which the timeline does not start at its region's left edge.

## The Fix

- Read the timeline's offset in its region from the center body's `columnPositions.get(<timeline dataField>).x`.
- `Neo.timeline.Column` and `Neo.timeline.TimeAxisHeader` window with the axis position `max(0, scrollLeft - offset)`, not the region's `scrollLeft`.
- `Neo.gantt.Container` mounts the dependency layer at the offset, passes it the axis position, and re-syncs it when the body's column positions change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] With an unlocked column before the timeline, every rendered link starts on its source bar's right edge and ends on its target bar's left edge (±2 px), at scroll 0 and after a horizontal scroll past that column.
- [ ] With the columns before the timeline wider than `bufferPx`, the bars and header ticks at the timeline's visible left edge render.
- [ ] A `responsiveLockPolicy` that unlocks columns at a narrow width keeps every link on its bars after the switch and after the switch back.
- [ ] A Playwright e2e spec proves it: red on `dev`, green at head.
- [ ] A Gantt whose columns are all locked draws its links where it does today (the `test/playwright/e2e/gantt/` specs stay green).

## Out of Scope

- The column order after a `responsiveLockPolicy` round trip: a column that leaves the locked region and comes back lands after the columns that stayed.
- Runtime `taskColumns` reassignment, which throws in `Neo.grid.header.Toolbar#passSizeToBody`.

## Avoided Traps

- **Offsetting by the locked regions' width.** Those are separate bodies; the offset is only the center-region columns before the timeline.
- **Moving the links into the timeline cells.** A link spans rows, so the layer stays one overlay in the body.
